rule: An output is excluded from scoring for every model when its reference depends on an engine input that the certified household data never carried and the prompt therefore never listed, and a careful reader could take the stated facts the other way. Excluded outputs stay in the published payload, marked scored=false, so every prompt and response remains inspectable.
derivation: All 1,984 references were recomputed with policyengine-us 1.755.4 (the version that produced them; base recompute matched the frozen CSV on every row) under each alternative reading; every output whose value moved is listed. 2026-09-05.

exclusions.alternative_reading: The person's listed Social Security disability income is read as 24 or more months of SSDI receipt (the engine input months_receiving_social_security_disability, integer-typed, never carried by the data and never promptable). Recomputed with policyengine-us 1.755.4.
exclusions.judge_verdict: llm_error (age_disability) where any row was judged
exclusions.note: In law the under-65 route needs 24 months of SSDI entitlement; a year-round recipient has at least 12. The facts do not settle it.
